reset.scope: Rebuild only a separate message-label module. No archived implementation copied or imported.
reset.shared_dependency: Active nm.shared.model_port supplies the existing provider interface, schema checks, token estimates and typed failures.
reset.historical_evidence: All previous integration, browser, cost and semantic observations below refer to the archived implementation, not the new component.

pass_condition: Code chooses the first-message or follow-up prompt before dispatch. One model call receives the exact latest message, and full attributed history only for a follow-up, then returns exactly one permitted whole-message label.
counterexample: The provider returns an unknown label, a list of several labels, an incomplete result or extra decision fields. Basic validation must not admit these as the requested whole-message label, while harmless case and whitespace variations remain accepted.

prompt.responsibility: Return one label for the whole latest message. No splitting, source-part selection, extraction, answer, planning, execution or saving.
prompt.selection: Code chooses one prompt before the call. Neither a position field nor instructions for both first and follow-up messages are sent together.

output.model: Exactly one label: greeting, information, action or mixed.
output.component: The checked label plus code-owned message_position, which is not sent for the model to decide.

checks: Output is the declared object with exactly one permitted label
Nonblank latest message, attributed history and explicit completeness confirmation
Full input, schema and output capacity fit without trimming
Provider result is complete and usable
mechanical_validation.normalization: Meaning-preserving case and surrounding whitespace variations in the label are accepted.
mechanical_validation.limits: The validator cannot establish semantic correctness or detect history withheld by the caller. Labels are proposals, not permission or factual findings.
mechanical_validation.recovery: Typed errors preserve available usage metrics. No internal retry or recovery ledger is introduced; an eventual turn controller must own bounded recovery.

mechanical_checks.scope: Standalone component contract with scripted provider outputs, distinct first/follow-up prompt selection, complete follow-up history, four allowed whole-message labels, harmless formatting, invalid shape, missing context, budget and incomplete-result cases.

call_impact.purpose: Classify the latest message in context only.
call_impact.whole_turn_call_count: Not established: the new turn pipeline is not rebuilt.
call_impact.provider_transport_retries: Remain an existing ModelPort/provider concern and are not a second semantic stage.

remaining_work: Rebuild and verify the context assembly boundary that certifies complete saved history.
Wire the separate label component into the rebuilt application without letting labels authorize work, change records or hide source text from downstream readers.
Rebuild the necessary routing, persistence, response and recovery boundaries before claiming an integrated feature.
Evaluate actual pinned-model labels and observe saved/reopened browser conversations for this new implementation. Synthetic checks do not establish semantic accuracy.
